rows.subject: Remove 8 MDPF_SECCLASS worktrees: tag each tip archive/MDPF_SECCLASS/<branch>, git worktree remove WITHOUT --force (dirty trees refuse and stay), drop branch names
rows.context: COO~M1 assessed 8 worktrees: unlanded r9 E_18 callers and r8 classification scripts, the rest records, 3-22 uncommitted files each. MSTR~DELL1 holds it as destructive git (msg 3437). Nothing waits on it; disk only.
rows.rec: YES. Every tip is kept as an archive tag, so no commit is lost. Without --force a dirty tree refuses to go, so no uncommitted file is lost either. The worst case is a tree that stays.
